ref_extractions.title: Seizure detection by analyzing the number of channels selected by cross-correlation using TUH EEG Seizure Corpus
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper explicitly uses 'The TUH EEG Seizure Corpus (TUSZ)' version 1.5.2 with the '02-tcp-le/' montage. It defines a concrete seizure detection task with binary classification (seizure vs background/non-seizure). The paper describes preprocessing (0.5-40 Hz bandpass), channel selection via cross-correlation, and evaluation using sensitivity metrics. The epoching method uses seizure start/end times from the .xls annotation files.

event_annotations.notes: No raw event IDs were detected in the dataset. Extensive probing of the TUH EEG Corpus v2.0.3 directory structure confirmed the existence of group directories (dev/, eval/, train/) and subject-level subdirectories (e.g., aaaaaayf, aaaaabep, aaaaaaxg, aaaaefp) using the v2.0.3/ prefix path. However, no actual EDF files or annotation files could be located within any subject directory using numerous filename patterns including: subject_id.edf, subject_id_01.edf, subject_id_s001_t000.edf, subject_id_s001.edf, subject_id_0001.edf, subject_id.rec, subject_id.tse, subject_id.seizure, subject_id.lbl, data.edf, numeric filenames, date-stamped filenames, and compressed .edf.gz variants. All file access attempts returned 'file not found'. The read_events_tsv tool was unavailable for probing potential BIDS-style annotations. Without detectable events.tsv, events.json, or accessible EDF headers containing event markers, no event IDs could be identified for annotation. The dataset appears to have no extractable event information through the available tools.

derived_misc_channels.name: seizure_label
derived_misc_channels.derivation: The TUH EEG Seizure Corpus provides seizure annotations in companion .csv/.xls files (not BIDS events.tsv). The kernel must parse these annotation files to create a binary label channel: 1 for seizure/ictal periods, 0 for background/interictal periods. Since no events.tsv numeric columns were discovered in pre-scan, the kernel must read the native TUH annotation format (seizure_start_time, seizure_stop_time fields) and construct a step-function misc channel aligned to the EEG time axis. Label 1=seizure, 0=background.
derived_misc_channels.groundable_evidence: No events.tsv columns discovered in pre-scan; annotations exist in external .xls files per ref 10.1117/12.2670106
